🕹️ Trial and error

Agent

In simple words

An AI that acts on its own to reach a goal: it notices what is happening, chooses an action and sees the result.

In AI, anything that acts to reach a goal: it observes its surroundings (its environment), chooses an action, sees what happens and chooses again. In reinforcement learning, the agent is the learner. By 2025, people also called chatbots that can use tools, search the web or click through websites to finish a task “AI agents”.

Example. A robot vacuum is a simple agent: it senses walls and dirt, decides where to go next, and its goal is a clean floor. In a video game, a character controlled by an AI is an agent too.

Related words

  • Reinforcement learningLearning by trial and error: an AI tries actions and gets rewards or penalties for the results.
  • RewardThe score an agent gets after an action, telling it how good the result was.
  • Exploration vs. exploitationThe choice an agent faces between trying something new (exploring) and using what already works (exploiting).
  • Q-learningA reinforcement learning method in which an agent learns a score (a Q-value) for every action in every situation.
  • RobotA machine that can sense its surroundings and move or act in the physical world.
  • Reward hackingWhen an AI finds a loophole that earns lots of reward without doing what its designers really wanted.
